basic_info.description: Lovingly remodeled and updated, this sun-drenched home is the perfect blend of modern conveniences and high tech touches with classic traditional details that exude warmth and charm throughout! The home boasts 3 generous bedrooms, updated full bath, living room with fireplace, crown moldings and hardwood floors, remodeled kitchen with Quartz counters and stainless appliances, plus a huge workshop/gym/storage room. The attached garage parks 2 cars in tandem and includes a laundry area with newer washer and dryer. The private, fenced rear yard is delightful with a variety of trees - fig, lemon, apricot, lime and avocado - as well as roses and hydrangea plants. Home improvements are numerous (see seller's list in the disclosure package) with highlights that include new light fixtures with dimmers, modern fixtures and updated hardware, solid core doors, Nest smart thermostat, and much more! Located in desirable Bernal Heights, the home is just steps from the many neighborhood-favorite restaurants, pubs, coffee houses and specialty shops that line Cortland Ave. Bernal Heights Park and Holly Park are nearby. And commuters will love easy access to US-101 and I-280. Walk score=93.
